description: READ ... PREVIOUS (keyed sequential read in reverse), §2023:14.9.30 Format 1 - introduced 2002. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 relative and indexed READ Format 1 is 'READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1]' (§1985:VIII.4.5.2, §1985:IX.4.5.2), NEXT its only direction; the 2002 Format 1 offers NEXT or PREVIOUS (§2002:14.8.29.1; 'None of the phrases ADVANCING, AT END, NEXT, NOT AT END, or PREVIOUS shall be specified if ACCESS MODE RANDOM is specified', §2002:14.8.29.2 SR6), 'If the PREVIOUS phrase is specified, the physical file associated with the file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall be a single reel/unit mass storage file' (§2002:14.8.29.3 GR17), and §2002:F.2 item 109 records 'READ PREVIOUS. The READ statement has been enhanced to allow reading the record prior to that pointed to by the file position indicator'. 2014 keeps it (§2014:14.9.29.2 SR5; §2014:14.9.29.3 GR18).
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:14.8.29 / §2002:F.2 item 109); rows 29/108 gate the after-OPEN behavior
